pr_title: planner: fix the fail when we compare multi fields in the subquery
pr_body:
<!-- Thank you for contributing to TiDB!

PR Title Format:
1. pkg [, pkg2, pkg3]: what's changed
2. *: what's changed

-->

### What problem does this PR solve?

Issue Number: close #13551  close #21674 

Problem Summary:
When we use `(SELECT c1, c2 FROM t2 LIMIT 1) = ANY (SELECT c1, c2 FROM t1)` in the `where` statement, the `expressionRewrite.ctxStack` will store the result value of `SELECT c1, c2 FROM t2 LIMIT 1`.  So in issue#21674, when the value of c1 is zero, the plan will be convert to `tableDual`.

### What is changed and how it works?
So, we should set `expressionRewrite.asScalar = true` like [`handleInSubquery`](https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/blob/master/planner/core/expression_rewriter.go#L822-L824) function. It will use the parent expression's last column from the schema to represents whether the condition is matched(https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/blob/master/planner/core/expression_rewriter.go#L558-L561).


### Related changes

- PR to update `pingcap/docs`/`pingcap/docs-cn`:
